name: eidolon
description: an Eidolon, a dark knight in black plate armour with gold trim and spiked black pauldrons, a closed black helm with two large curved brown horns and a glowing red cross-shaped visor, a red glowing cross on the chest, a tattered red tabard and red cloth strips flaring at the hips, black armoured boots, a tall black halberd with a steel crescent axe blade, a spear spike on top and a red cross on the blade, held upright in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, and an open black clawed gauntlet with a red rune raised in his RIGHT hand on the screen-left side
hands: the halberd stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty open gauntlet on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the halberd is lifted up over the head with its crescent axe blade and spike pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the halberd cocked behind the head with its axe head hanging down behind the shoulders, the open right gauntlet tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the halberd is level, its axe head pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: halberd arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the crescent axe blade chopping down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the open gauntlet arm swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the halberd carries on down until its axe head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, red tabard strips trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the halberd lifts back toward the upright ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the horned helm snaps back toward the upper-left, the red visor flaring, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the open right gauntlet flung out to the left, the halberd arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the halberd dipping, the open gauntlet still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, halberd arm flung up, the open gauntlet drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the horned helm droops, the halberd lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the halberd's axe head resting on the ground, the gauntlet arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the halberd slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, horns on the ground; the halberd lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red tabard spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red tabard settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the red visor gone dark, the halberd on the ground beside him
